LOREBATT procedures ported directly into LoreBattle (PlusExperience, PlusGold, ExistEnemies, AttackOne, CastOne, CastAll, CastSpecial, BattleESP, RunAway, enemy WeaponAttack/castattack*/enemycure/specialattack/SpecialCastAttack/EnemyAttack, EndBattle, auto-select k=8) with source texts, random order (operand evaluation checked separately against the EXE, see milestone104), Pascal div/round, byte wrap of dec(ac) and the for-bound capture of enemynumber; BattleViewportView now selects every person's command first (battle[person,1..3]), then executes in person order, runs the enemy phase and judges EndBattle only afterwards, with per-round autobattle and run-away exit. Cure runs at selection through FieldMagicLogic (messages suppressed when etc[6] <> 0). Unverified compiler behaviour: Random(0), round at .5, byte wrap, summon id out of range. DOS comparison pending. Independent native prison battle reward scope: test/battle_rewards_dos_test.dart and test/fixtures/dos_battle_rewards.json compare all six records, signed longint EXP/gold assignments, conscious actor vs unconscious shared rewards, original E_number template gold, and real mobile battle/continuation/save including ReadKey focus. Original EXE and FOEDATA remain unchanged. Other operand widths and whole-program RNG/new-game-to-ending parity remain unverified. Milestone114 adds independent live, unchanged DOSBox RAM evidence from the cold-created party: 29 actual field moves to Earth Worm, automatic victory including six player records, enemy records and the exact RandSeed, then 36 moves to Troll/Serpent/Goblin and a failed pre-battle escape followed by the enemy phase. test/first_field_battle_dos_test.dart and test/first_field_battle_dos_ui_test.dart replay the same seeds continuously through the real mobile screen. tool/capture_dos_battle_memory.py checks preserved raw bytes, decoded records, original EXE hash and the movement/encounter draw stream. No native RAM/RNG writes, no synthetic native inputs. Scope is these observed branches; second battle completion, MENACE entry and the full campaign remain pending.

Byte product uses low-word MUL/MUL + CWD/unsigned DIV20; high sign-bit product raises a native division fault (engine StateError; DOS error-screen presentation remains separate). Magic cost/base overflow, enemy attack defence and whole-game replay remain separate gates; partial retained.
